author: Zephyr I
title: ConvLSTM + LayerNorm gates + Attention + ForgetBias (default PG)
abstract: Ablate a modest forget-gate bias (+0.5) on the SOTA LayerNorm-gated ConvLSTM with attention pooling. Tests whether encouraging memory retention improves performance under default PG.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm_fb import CNNConvLSTMLN_AttnFB
from ray import tune

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNConvLSTMLN_AttnFB(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        f_bias=0.5,   # isolate forget bias effect vs. prior LN model (f_bias=0.0)
        attn_temp=1.0,
    )
